name: agentpc
description: Instant, resettable Windows, Ubuntu and Arch Linux ARM desktop VMs for AI agents on Apple Silicon Macs.
long_description: Create, screenshot, drive and reset local Windows 11 (ARM64), Ubuntu (any release) and Arch Linux ARM desktop VMs over MCP. x64 Windows apps run through Prism, and an Ubuntu image with FEX runs x86_64 Linux programs and amd64 containers. Requires QEMU from Homebrew (brew install qemu). Ubuntu and Arch images download on first use (Arch builds locally, ~6 min, only if the download fails); Windows needs a one-time `agentpc image build windows`, which downloads the ISO from Microsoft.

tools.name: list_vms
tools.description: VMs (state, owner, size, checkpoints) and which images exist

tools.name: create_vm
tools.description: Create a VM (optionally a given OS version, size, or offline); ready in seconds once its image exists

tools.name: start_vm
tools.description: Start an instance

tools.name: stop_vm
tools.description: Stop an instance

tools.name: reset_vm
tools.description: Discard all changes: back to a fresh copy of the image

tools.name: checkpoint_vm
tools.description: Save a VM's disk and memory under a label

tools.name: restore_vm
tools.description: Put a VM back exactly as it was at a checkpoint (resumes in seconds)

tools.name: delete_checkpoint
tools.description: Delete a VM's checkpoint

tools.name: delete_vm
tools.description: Stop and delete an instance with its disk and checkpoints

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Hypervisor screenshot of an instance

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command (PowerShell on Windows, bash on Ubuntu and Arch); returns the exit code, stdout and stderr, or runs it in the background

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: State, exit code and log tail of a background run_command job

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Copy a file or folder from this Mac into a VM

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Copy a file or folder from a VM to this Mac

tools.name: forward_port
tools.description: Reach a server running in a VM (even one bound to the VM's localhost) from this Mac

tools.name: list_forwards
tools.description: List a VM's active port forwards

tools.name: delete_forward
tools.description: Stop a port forward

tools.name: read_vm_log
tools.description: Tail a VM's QEMU or serial log

tools.name: list_desktop_tools
tools.description: List the desktop-control tools inside an instance

tools.name: use_desktop_tool
tools.description: Call a desktop-control tool inside an instance
